yoke.column.name: Yoke (roll / pitch)
yoke.column.note: yoke shaft/hub where the wheel meets the base (roll / pitch)

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), seen from the front-left: yoke wheel in front of the base, base box behind with its clamps
mappingSource: catalog only (thrustmaster.json, sources: product pages https://www.thrustmaster.com/products/tca-sky-yoke-xbox-pc/ and .../tca-sky-yoke-playstation-pc/); no manual mapping published yet, the catalog part has no input numbers
note: The catalog lists only the yoke roll/pitch for this new (2026) product; the many grip and centre-panel buttons, the thumb sticks/hats on both horns and the side controls on the base visible on this photo have no catalog parts yet. mapping-confidence medium only states that the part is the yoke column; its axis numbers are not in the catalog.
